entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Otto Heinrich Fugger, Count of Kirchberg and Weissenhorn was a German professional soldier in Imperial and Bavarian service during the Thirty Year's War. Born into the ennobled mercantile family Fugger, he chose a military career in which he became a Knight of the Golden Fleece and served as governor and military commander of Augsburg.
